fullPassage: We not only absorb our moral codes and definitions of right and wrong from the group; the group also transmits cues about cooperation and defection and what it means to act in a trustworthy manner. People are more likely to suppress their self-interest in favor of the group interest if they feel that others are doing so as well, and they’re less likely to do so if they feel that others are taking advantage of them. The psychological mechanism for this is unclear, but certainly it is related to our innate sense of fairness. We generally don’t mind sacrificing for the group, as long as we’re all sacrificing equally. But if we feel like we’re being taken advantage of by others who are defecting, we’re more likely to defect as well.

questions.passage:
(A) The student managed to <u>absorb</u> all the key concepts before the final exam by reviewing her notes every evening.
(B) A thick sponge can <u>absorb</u> a large amount of water within seconds, making it useful for cleaning spills.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 absorb의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: absorb: (A) 핵심 개념을 이해하다/습득하다 / (B) 물을 빨아들이다/흡수하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 흡수하다(액체) — (B) 이해하다: (A)는 개념 습득이고 (B)는 액체 흡수이므로 의미가 뒤바뀜
✅ ② (A) 이해하다 — (B) 흡수하다(액체): (A)는 시험 전 핵심 개념을 이해/습득하는 것, (B)는 스펀지가 물을 물리적으로 흡수하는 것으로 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 이해하다 — (B) 방출하다: (B)는 흡수이지 방출이 아님
❌ ④ (A) 거부하다 — (B) 흡수하다(액체): (A)는 개념을 습득한 것이지 거부한 것이 아님
det.tip: absorb: 1. (지식을) 이해하다/습득하다 2. (액체를) 흡수하다/빨아들이다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "existing from birth rather than being learned or acquired through experience"

det.korean: innate=타고난 (경험을 통해 배우거나 습득한 것이 아니라 태어날 때부터 존재하는)
det.analysis:
❌ ① moral: moral(도덕적인)은 선천적이라는 의미와 다름
✅ ② innate: innate(타고난)는 태어날 때부터 존재하는 것으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ psychological: psychological(심리적인)은 마음과 관련된 것으로 선천적이라는 의미와 다름
❌ ④ mutual: mutual(상호적인)은 선천적이라는 의미와 무관
det.tip: innate = inborn = inherent = 타고난, 선천적인

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the act of abandoning a group, cause, or allegiance"

det.korean: defection=이탈 (집단이나 대의, 충성을 저버리는 행위)
det.analysis:
✅ ① defection: defection(이탈)은 집단이나 충성을 저버리는 행위로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ② cooperation: cooperation(협력)은 이탈과 반대 의미
❌ ③ sacrifice: sacrifice(희생)는 집단을 위해 양보하는 것으로 이탈과 다름
❌ ④ mechanism: mechanism(기제)은 작동 방식으로 이탈과 무관
det.tip: defection = abandonment = desertion = 이탈, 탈영

questions.passage: People are more likely to suppress their self-interest in favor of the group interest if they feel that others are doing so as well, and they’re less likely to do so if they feel that others are __________ (take) advantage of them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 진행형: are + V-ing (다른 사람이 자신을 이용하고 있다고 느끼면)
det.analysis: others are __________ advantage of them에서 are 뒤에 현재분사가 와야 진행형(be + V-ing)이 완성된다. take → taking
det.tip: be + V-ing (진행형) — are taking advantage of them

overlay.excerptSentences: People are more likely to suppress their self-interest in favor of the group interest if they feel that others are doing so as well, and they’re less likely to do so if they feel that others are __________ (take) advantage of them.

questions.passage: We not only absorb our moral codes and definitions of right and wrong from the group; the group also transmits cues about cooperation and defection and what it means to act in a trustworthy manner. People are more likely to suppress their self-interest in favor of the group interest if they feel that others are doing so as well, and they’re less likely to do so if they feel that others are taking advantage of them. The psychological mechanism for this is unclear, but certainly it is related to our innate sense of fairness. We generally don’t mind sacrificing for the group, as long as __________. But if we feel like we’re being taken advantage of by others who are defecting, we’re more likely to defect as well.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: we're all sacrificing equally=우리 모두 동등하게 희생하는 한 — 공정성 감각의 구체적 조건
det.analysis:
❌ ① others are competing fairly: 공정하게 경쟁하는 것은 희생과 다른 맥락
❌ ② the group makes decisions: 집단이 결정을 내리는 것은 동등한 희생이라는 조건과 다름
✅ ③ we're all sacrificing equally: 원문 일치. 모두가 동등하게 희생하는 한 집단을 위한 희생을 개의치 않는다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ the mechanism is understood: 기제가 이해되는 것은 희생의 조건이 아님
det.tip: don't mind sacrificing, as long as we're all sacrificing equally — 동등한 희생이 조건

questions.passage: We not only absorb our moral codes and definitions of right and wrong from the group; the group also transmits cues about cooperation and defection and what it means to act in a trustworthy manner. People are more likely to suppress their self-interest in favor of the group interest if they feel that others are doing so as well, and they’re less likely to do so if they feel that others are __________. The psychological mechanism for this is unclear, but certainly it is related to our innate sense of fairness. We generally don’t mind sacrificing for the group, as long as we’re all sacrificing equally. But if we feel like we’re being taken advantage of by others who are defecting, we’re more likely to defect as well.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: taking advantage of them=그들을 이용하는 — 다른 사람이 이용하고 있다고 느끼면 협력 감소
det.analysis:
❌ ① sacrificing for the group: 집단을 위해 희생하는 것은 오히려 협력을 촉진하는 맥락이므로 less likely와 모순
❌ ② transmitting clear cues: 명확한 단서를 전달하는 것은 집단 기능이지 이용하는 것과 다름
❌ ③ following the moral codes: 도덕 규범을 따르는 것은 긍정적이므로 less likely와 모순
✅ ④ taking advantage of them: 원문 일치. 다른 사람이 자신을 이용하고(taking advantage of) 있다고 느끼면 협력할 가능성이 낮아진다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: less likely to do so if they feel that others are taking advantage of them — 이용당한다는 느낌이 핵심
